## About the job

This position is needed to help operate, secure, and modernize Twilio's shared Kubernetes platform substrate (OTK, Segment, and ZipWhip EKS fleets) at scale.
Join our Cloud Native Container Operations team as an entry-level platform engineer. You will help manage over 1,000 Kubernetes clusters, tackling real-world multi-cloud complexity. This high-impact role offers structured mentorship from senior engineers, hands-on experience with modern automation tools, and a direct path to improving platform reliability. It is the perfect environment to launch your career in infrastructure engineering at a massive scale.

## Responsibilities

In this role, you'll:
• Assist in lifecycle management of cloud hosted Kubernetes platforms serving all of Twilio.
• Remediate container and kernel-level CVE vulnerabilities to keep the shared substrate secure.
• Write automation scripts in Go and Shell to streamline day-to-day cluster operations.
• Collaborate with senior engineers to deploy infrastructure changes safely using Terraform and GitOps.
• Troubleshoot basic platform issues, applying lessons learned to continuously improve system reliability.

## Qualifications

• Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply.
• If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio.
• We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

## Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical training.
• Foundational programming skills in Go (Golang) and scripting with Shell.
• Basic exposure to cloud environments, specifically AWS.
• Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code concepts using Terraform and YAML.
• Academic or internship exposure to containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
• Practical understanding of version control (Git) and core software development life cycle (SDLC) concepts.
Desired:
• Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools like ArgoCD.
• Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, and distributed systems.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) for coding or debugging.
• Strong problem-solving skills and an eagerness to learn complex infrastructure concepts.

## Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

• Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more.
• Offerings vary by location.

Internship | Remote | 2 months | No Stipend

## About PARQIS

PARQIS is India’s only video-first curated marketplace connecting Gen Z and millennial consumers with verified Indian brands. The platform enables a seamless journey from content discovery to purchase, all within a single, engaging experience. As a growing startup, PARQIS works closely with brands to deliver authentic and high-quality products, with a strong focus on innovation and user engagement.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a resourceful Mobile App Developer to bring our fully functional, responsive web platform to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Instead of rebuilding our platform from scratch, your primary objective is to build a high-performance native wrapper app (WebView container) around our existing web infrastructure. You will design a secure mobile shell, integrate native device features, and own the end-to-end deployment pipeline.

What We Are Building

A cross-platform mobile application (iOS and Android) that securely hosts and displays our responsive web platform using a full-screen, native web-view container. A hybrid experience that blends our web-based features with essential native mobile utilities. We want to explore the best architectural path for this wrapper—whether that means leveraging a unified framework like CapacitorJS or React Native, or utilizing an optimized PWA + TWA (Trusted Web Activity) approach where supported.

## Key Responsibilities

App Containerization: Build and maintain the mobile application shell targeting both iOS and Android platforms.

• Native Feature Integration: Implement device-level features over the web interface, such as native push notifications, secure local biometrics (FaceID/TouchID), smooth splash screens, and hardware back-button handling.

• UI/UX Polishing: Optimize the web-to-mobile user flow, addressing safe-area layouts (camera notches, bottom gesture bars) and ensuring seamless session and checkout management.

• App Store Publishing: Own the end-to-end deployment lifecycle on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store—handling provisioning profiles, signing certificates, build submissions, and navigating the app review process to ensure store compliance.

## Qualifications & Skills

• Mobile Development Experience: Proven track record of packaging and deploying mobile applications using hybrid or cross-platform web-wrapper approaches (such as CapacitorJS, React Native, or automated PWA to TWA container pipelines).

Web Foundations: Strong proficiency in core web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3) and mobile-first frontend responsiveness.

Platform SDK Tools: Hands-on experience building, debugging, and archiving binaries inside Xcode and Android Studio.

• Store Publishing Success: Direct experience navigating the Google Play Console and Apple Developer portal, including managing TestFlight beta tracks and resolving store review feedback.

## Preferred/Nice-to-Have

Experience adapting embedded browser engines to handle external checkouts and third-party social authentication (OAuth) constraints.

Familiarity with writing lightweight native code (Swift, Kotlin, or Java) if a custom bridge plugin required.

What You’ll Gain

Hands-on experience building and deploying real-world mobile applications for iOS & Android

• Exposure to hybrid app architectures using WebView
• PWA + TWA
• and native integrations

Practical experience with app publishing workflows on Google Play Store & Apple App Store

Opportunity to contribute to a live consumer-facing platform used by Gen Z and millennial audiences

PPO opportunity based on performance and contribution.
